_about: Budgets for ui-benchmark.cjs, held by ui-budgets.test.cjs (docs/performance.md#the-app-window). Each is about 3 times the 2026-11-03 baseline on a 4-CPU Linux build machine, so CI noise doesn't fail it and a real regression does. large_list_ms is today's number plus headroom, not a goal: a workspace of 5,000 items draws every row. Lower a budget when a change makes the app faster; raising one needs the reason in the pull request.
